The eclipse-tractusx/portal-frontend TSX and SCSS file headers declare Apache-2.0. Verified root LICENSE, LICENSE_non-code and NOTICE.md recover the referenced notice context. It references DEPENDENCIES for third-party content; dependency-level applicability remains unresolved.

Counts describe evidence coverage, not source quality, source-use approval or eligible yield; host origin does not establish copied-source provenance.
